prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Restore Your Account Companion", "Sign in with your previous credentials to recover your adopted desktop pets and customized settings.", "Signing in syncs your account vault and recovers all previously adopted desktop companions."]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "Verifying desktop overlay capabilities and rendering assets...", "Desktop Overlay Test"]
2: ["Your Companion Is Ready!", "Learn basic interactions before sending your pet to your live desktop environment."]
3: ["Upload & Verify Companion Photo", "Our real-time inspector checks photo clarity and 3D pet generation compatibility.", "3D Render Inspection"]
4: ["Signing in syncs your account vault and restores your existing desktop companions."]
5: ["Checking display server, system tray, and GPU rendering compatibility..."]
6: ["Ensure subject face is clearly visible with good lighting to prevent custom model generation artifacts."]
7: ["Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "Signing this certificate links your companion permanently to your account cloud vault.", "Confirm Adoption & Spawn"]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Select how you'd like to bring your new pet companion to life."]
9: ["Companion Ready to Launch", "Click below to spawn your pet directly onto your desktop workspace.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
